info.name: JanMat API
info.description:
HTTP API for the JanMat civic-democracy platform (janmat-api / Axum).

Set `baseUrl` to one of:
  • http://localhost:3000      — the API directly (docker compose default)
  • http://localhost:8080/api  — through the nginx reverse proxy

Every request ships with a saved example response. 'Create topic' and 'Create vote' capture the returned ULID (namespace prefix stripped) into {{topicId}} / {{voteId}} so the path-param requests below work as-is.

Identity: register with PAN+Aadhaar+DOB+phone and a unique username (POC — no external verification); log in by username.
